3D Etch A Sketch is an interactive creative coding experiment by Brian Dillon. Using Spatial p5, a Meta Quest 3S, and a game controller, Brian recreated the classic Etch A Sketch in a 3D environment. Controller support was initially prototyped with the [JavaScript Gamepad API in a 2D p5.js sketch](https://editor.p5js.org/dillob01/full/k7DteX5g8).

You can explore the full project in the [Spatial p5 Editor](https://editor.spatialp5.com/?), tested with Meta Quest 3S, Sony DualSense, and Xbox controllers.

[Brian Dillon](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brian-dillon-md-a01740124) is an interventional radiologist currently pursuing a Master's in Integrated Design and Media at NYU Tandon.
